Sandbox_CorpseProxyLab_BloodTrailDensity: Sparse trails create fewer splats. Density is capped at high speed. Does not affect body or clothing wear; existing blood remains.
Sandbox_CorpseProxyLab_ClothingWear_tool: Clothing wears with distance; damage is applied in batches. At zero condition it is unequipped and remains as a broken loot item. Bags, contents and player corpses are protected. Disabling does not repair damage.
Sandbox_CorpseProxyLab_CosmeticWear_tool: Skin gradually gains blood and dirt. Clothing and items remain intact. Disabling stops new marks without removing existing ones.
Sandbox_CorpseProxyLab_HorseTowing_toolt: Requires Horse. A mounted horse can tow bodies without changing its speed or stamina. Disabled or riderless horses keep their links without towing.
Sandbox_CorpseProxyLab_BloodTrails_toolt: Dragged bodies leave blood on the ground; skeletons do not. Disabling stops new splats but does not clean the ground.
Sandbox_CorpseProxyLab_Enabled_tooltip: When disabled, bodies stop being towed and new attachments are blocked. Existing tethers remain saved and can be removed to recover their items.
Sandbox_CorpseProxyLab_VehicleDrag_toolt: Taut tethers apply resistance from bodies and their contents. Vehicle stats are not changed.
Sandbox_CorpseProxyLab_AllowPlayerCorpse: Allow towing non-zombie human corpses. Existing attachments remain detachable.
Sandbox_CorpseProxyLab_AllowDetachOthers: When disabled, only the owner may change an attachment. Old unowned attachments remain available to everyone. Multiplayer only.
Sandbox_CorpseProxyLab_MaxBodiesPerChain: Default 32 per independent train from a vehicle. 0 means unlimited. Large trains increase processing load. Lowering this does not detach existing bodies.
Sandbox_CorpseProxyLab_ClothingWearRate_: One garment is damaged every 40 / 20 / 10 m. Changing the rate does not repair items.
Sandbox_CorpseProxyLab_BodyWear_tooltip: Towing turns zombie bodies into skeletons, destroying clothing and ALL contained items, then removes the remains. Player bodies are protected. Tethers and other bodies remain. Disabling does not restore items.
Sandbox_CorpseProxyLab_BodyWearRate_tool: Body travel distance to become a skeleton; another half of that distance to disappear. Standing still does not count.
Sandbox_CorpseProxyLab_BodySpread_toolti: Gently spreads the entire crowded group of bodies only while taut individual tethers pull them. Does not align bodies with the vehicle. Chains of bodies are unchanged; obstacles and tether lengths take priority. Overlaps remain possible.
Sandbox_CorpseProxyLab_BodySpreadWidth_t: Preferred lateral spacing for bodies on similarly long tethers. Does not change collision size.
Sandbox_CorpseProxyLab_BodySpreadStrengt: Maximum separation speed. Correction is also limited by actual displacement from tether pull.
Sandbox_CorpseProxyLab_CarcassWear_toolt: Reduces the vanilla meat ratio: first 100 m free, then 1 percent per 100 m, capped at 10 percent. Affects meat quantity and nutrition. Does not change decay or inventory. Disabling does not restore resources.
Sandbox_CorpseProxyLab_CarcassWearRate_t: Changes wear accumulation: half, normal or double speed.
